scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('public')) fs.mkdirSync('public'); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'public/index.html'); if(fs.existsSync('_headers')) fs.copyFileSync('_headers', 'public/_headers'); if(fs.existsSync('public/_redirects')) fs.unlinkSync('public/_redirects'); console.log('✅ Build complete');"
